purpose: Trace accepted N0TE scope from requirement through implementation, reachability, execution evidence and real artist value without collapsing those states into one another.
rules: Missing evidence keeps that state unproven rather than inferred from adjacent evidence.
Unit tests may prove implementation behavior but do not automatically prove user reachability or artist value.
Documentation may reference evidence but is not itself sufficient proof of product completion.
Foreground selection never removes retained requirements from the spine.
Semantic deduplication may merge duplicate evidence or duplicate work expressions, not distinct accepted requirements.
Acceptance can be revoked when fresh contradictory evidence appears, while historical evidence remains retained.

golden_journey_evidence.purpose: Use a compact set of real TellMeN0TE journeys to prove Consumer Health and Value Health.
candidate_journeys: resume a real Song with correct Artist/Song context and prior decisions
cloud-to-local handoff with one trace and no duplicate mutation
preserve and recover project/version lineage after an edit
prepare a release package from current Song state with rights and metadata checks
reconcile provider/public artist state without stale-memory overwrite
recover cleanly from a partial executor or provider failure
golden_journey_evidence.capture_rule: Prefer evidence captured during legitimate real work over synthetic manual QA when safety and privacy permit.
